title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own): Flood Claim Intake and Adjuster Reports
content:
### Claim intake standard — NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own)

**What a flood is.** A claim is taken for direct physical loss by or from flood — a general and temporary condition of partial or complete inundation of two or more acres of normally dry land or of two or more properties, at least one of which is the insured's, from overflow of inland or tidal waters, unusual and rapid accumulation or runoff of surface waters, mudflow, or collapse of land along a shore caused by erosion or undermining from flood.

**Coverage period.** A claim is covered only when the date of loss falls on or after the date the coverage took effect and before the policy's cancellation effective date or term end, a loss in renewal grace being covered only if the renewal premium is then received inside the grace period. The date of loss is the one the insured reports at first notice and the claim file records; it is compared with the effective date, the cancellation effective date and the term end on the policy record.

**First notice and contact.** The claim number is assigned at first notice, and the assigned adjuster contacts the insured within the tier's adjuster contact standard, in elapsed hours, under Tidemark's servicing standard.

**Adjuster reports.** Every adjuster report records the measured building loss at replacement cost and at actual cash value, the contents loss at actual cash value, the part of the contents loss in the special-items class and whether the building is a total loss. A final report supersedes earlier reports on the claim, and a supplemental report filed after it supersedes it for the coverages it measures.

| Date of loss | Covered |
|---|---|
| Before the date the coverage took effect | No |
| On or after the effective date and before the term end (no cancellation) | Yes |
| On or after the cancellation effective date | No |
| In renewal grace, renewal premium then received inside the grace period | Yes |
| In renewal grace, renewal premium not received inside the grace period | No |

*Hypothetical case.* A loss on the day coverage took effect falls "on or after" the effective date and is inside the coverage period; a loss on the cancellation effective date itself is not, because the period runs only to before that date.
